title: Do This Before the First Freeze (Renters) #shorts

segments.text: A small crack in a frozen pipe can leak over two hundred fifty gallons of water a day. Do these four things before the first freeze.
One. On really cold nights, let cold water trickle from faucets on outside walls. Moving water is harder to freeze.
Two. Open the cabinet doors under your sinks, so warm air can reach the pipes.
Three. Unhook your garden hose, and drain it.
Four. Leaving town? Keep the heat at fifty-five degrees or higher.
If a pipe does freeze, never use a torch or open flame. A hair dryer is safer. Can't find the frozen spot? Call your landlord or a plumber.
Follow RenterFix for one fix at a time.
